title: Forgotten Windows password
symptom: User cannot sign in after a long weekend.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Verified identity by phone and employee ID. 2) Checked account was not locked in the directory. 3) Reset password and set 'must change at next sign-in'.
resolution: Password reset; user changed it at first login.

title: Outlook keeps asking for password
symptom: Outlook shows a password prompt every few minutes.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Checked mailbox works in the web client (it does). 2) Cleared saved credentials in Credential Manager. 3) Restarted Outlook and signed in again.
resolution: Old cached credential removed; prompt stopped.

title: VPN client fails with 'connection timed out'
symptom: Field supervisor cannot connect to VPN from home.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Confirmed the user has internet (ping 8.8.8.8). 2) Tried another network (mobile hotspot): VPN connected. 3) Home router blocked the VPN port; advised changing the VPN profile to TCP 443.
resolution: Profile switched to TCP 443; connected from home.

title: Laptop very slow after startup
symptom: Boot takes 6+ minutes, fan always loud.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Task Manager: disk at 100%. 2) Found 14 startup apps and a pending Windows update. 3) Disabled non-essential startup apps, finished the update, ran Disk Cleanup.
resolution: Boot time reduced to under 1 minute.

title: Printer shows 'Offline'
symptom: Finance printer offline on one PC only.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Other PCs print fine, so the printer is OK. 2) Checked the printer port: IP changed after a router restart. 3) Updated the port to the printer's new IP and set a DHCP reservation.

title: Cannot install PDF reader
symptom: Installer is blocked by 'administrator required'.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Confirmed software is on the approved list. 2) Installed it remotely with admin rights. 3) Added it to the standard software image.

title: Phishing e-mail clicked
symptom: User entered credentials on a fake invoice page.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Disabled the account immediately. 2) Reset password and revoked active sessions. 3) Searched mail logs for the same sender, found 3 more recipients and removed the message. 4) Scanned the PC with Defender, clean. 5) Reminded user about reporting suspicious mail.
resolution: Account secured within the hour; no data loss found.

title: Account locked after wrong passwords
symptom: Account lockout after phone sync used an old password.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Checked lockout source: the user's phone mail app. 2) Removed and re-added the mail account on the phone. 3) Unlocked the account.

title: Onboard 2 new dispatchers
symptom: Two new employees start Monday.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Created accounts using the onboarding script. 2) Added both to the Operations group. 3) Prepared two laptops and updated the asset sheet.
resolution: Both accounts and laptops ready on Friday.

title: Charging dashboard not loading
symptom: Dispatchers cannot see charger status; 12 vehicles waiting.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Reproduced: web page returns HTTP 503. 2) Checked the application service on the server: stopped. 3) Restarted the service and checked the log: database connection timeout after a nightly backup. 4) Raised the backup job's timeout window.
resolution: Service restored in 1.5 hours; root cause documented.

title: Docking station not charging laptop
symptom: Laptop charges only through the wall charger.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Tested with another dock: works. 2) Checked dock power adapter wattage: too low. 3) Replaced with 90W adapter.

title: Cannot send attachments over 20 MB
symptom: Mail bounces with 'message too large'.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Explained the 20 MB mail limit. 2) Showed how to share via the company file share link. 3) Wrote a KB article on large files.

title: Ubuntu server cannot resolve hostnames
symptom: 'ping google.com' fails but 'ping 8.8.8.8' works.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Diagnosed DNS: 'resolvectl status' showed no DNS server. 2) Added the correct DNS servers in netplan. 3) Applied with 'sudo netplan apply'.

title: Laptop battery drains in 40 minutes
symptom: Battery health bad, shuts down suddenly.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Ran 'powercfg /batteryreport': health 38%. 2) Confirmed it is out of warranty cycle. 3) Issued a spare laptop and ordered a battery.
resolution: Spare laptop issued same day; battery replaced later.

title: Excel macro blocked
symptom: A macro workbook from a vendor will not run.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) File came from e-mail, so it is marked 'blocked'. 2) Scanned it: clean. 3) Unblocked via file Properties and added the folder as a Trusted Location.

title: Need access to the shared Sales folder
symptom: User moved to Sales, cannot open the shared folder.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Checked manager approval. 2) Added the user to the sales-users group. 3) Asked the user to sign out and in.

title: Internet down in the whole office
symptom: No website opens for all 80 users.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Checked the switch: link lights OK. 2) Router could not reach ISP gateway. 3) Power-cycled the ISP modem, then verified WAN link. 4) Contacted the ISP with the fault ticket and enabled the backup LTE link.
resolution: Backup link up in 20 min; ISP fixed fault in 2.8 hours.

title: Scanner saves blank pages
symptom: Scan-to-folder gives empty PDFs.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Cleaned the glass and tested copy: fine. 2) Scan-to-folder profile used the wrong paper size. 3) Reset the profile to A4.

title: Dispatcher locked out before shift
symptom: Cannot sign in; shift starts in 30 minutes.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Verified identity. 2) Found the password expired. 3) Reset password and confirmed sign-in.

title: Teams camera not detected
symptom: Camera works in Camera app but not in Teams.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Checked Teams device settings: no camera selected. 2) Updated camera driver. 3) Restarted Teams.

title: One PC has no network, others fine
symptom: Network icon shows 'unidentified network'.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Tested cable on another port: works, so the port is bad. 2) Checked the wall-to-switch patch cable. 3) Moved the cable to a free switch port and verified link.
resolution: Moved to a free port; faulty port labelled for replacement.

title: Laptop screen flickers
symptom: Screen flickers when moving the lid.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Tested an external monitor: stable. 2) Updated the graphics driver. 3) Issue continued, so ordered a replacement display cable.

title: Failed SSH login attempts
symptom: Log shows hundreds of failed SSH logins from one IP.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Checked '/var/log/auth.log'. 2) Blocked the IP with ufw. 3) Disabled password login and enabled key-only SSH. 4) Installed fail2ban.

title: New phone cannot get company mail
symptom: Mail app says 'cannot verify server identity'.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Confirmed the phone date/time was wrong. 2) Set automatic time. 3) Re-added the mail account.

title: Printout has black lines
symptom: Vertical lines on every page.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Ran the printer cleaning cycle. 2) Lines remained, so replaced the toner cartridge. 3) Printed a test page.

title: Wrong charging schedule in app
symptom: Vehicles charge at peak tariff hours.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Compared schedule settings with the tariff table. 2) Found the time zone set to UTC. 3) Changed to IST and re-saved schedules.

title: Leaver: disable accounts of 3 employees
symptom: Three contractors finished their contracts today.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Ran the offboarding script in dry-run to check. 2) Disabled the accounts and removed groups. 3) Collected laptops and updated the asset sheet.

title: Request for a PDF editor licence
symptom: User needs to edit PDFs weekly.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Checked licence pool: 4 free seats. 2) Got manager approval. 3) Assigned a licence and updated the licence sheet.

title: Cannot reach a server from the office LAN
symptom: Ping to the file server times out from one subnet.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) 'traceroute' stopped at the router. 2) Found a missing static route to the server subnet. 3) Added the route and saved the configuration.

title: MFA prompt not arriving
symptom: Authenticator code never appears.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Checked phone notifications: disabled for the app. 2) Enabled notifications. 3) Re-registered the authenticator.

title: USB headset not recognised
symptom: Headset not shown in sound settings.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Tried another USB port and PC: works. 2) Checked Device Manager: driver error. 3) Reinstalled the USB audio driver.

title: Question about booking a meeting room
symptom: User asked how to book rooms in the calendar.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Sent the room-booking KB article. 2) Offered a 5-minute demo.

title: Shared mailbox missing
symptom: Finance team lost access to the shared mailbox.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Checked mailbox permissions: group removed by an old script. 2) Re-added the group with Full Access. 3) Cleared the Outlook cache.

title: Windows Update stuck at 30%
symptom: PC stuck on 'working on updates'.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Waited 30 minutes. 2) Ran the Windows Update troubleshooter. 3) Cleared 'SoftwareDistribution' folder and retried.

title: Wi-Fi drops in the garage
symptom: Handheld scanners lose signal near the chargers.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Walked the area with a Wi-Fi analyzer. 2) Signal -78 dBm, too weak. 3) Moved the access point and set the channel to 11.

title: New printer not found
symptom: User cannot add the printer.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Checked the printer IP: correct. 2) Added printer by IP using the manufacturer driver. 3) Added the same driver to the deployment image.

title: Calendar invites not syncing
symptom: Invites appear on the PC but not on the phone.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Checked sync settings. 2) Removed and re-added the account on the phone. 3) Verified a new invite synced.

title: Report export to Excel fails
symptom: 'Export' button shows an error.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Reproduced the error and read the log: output path not writable. 2) Fixed folder permissions. 3) Exported again.

title: Mouse pointer jumps
symptom: Pointer moves by itself.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) Cleaned the sensor. 2) Changed batteries. 3) Replaced the mouse.

title: Cleanup of full disk on test server
symptom: Disk 96% used.
troubleshooting_steps: 1) 'df -h' and 'du -sh /var/*'. 2) Found old logs. 3) Ran the disk cleanup script.
